counterfactual_missing_items: Severe loss of dopamine transporter binding in basal ganglia
Almost total loss in caudate nucleus
decisive_items: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del)
Large-amplitude, long-duration motor unit potential in frontalis, mentalis, orbicularis oculi, and genioglossus muscles
response.rationale: R3 best integrates the bulbofacial lower motor neuron EMG, tongue atrophy, and upper motor neuron/pyramidal context with a TBK1 variant on the ALS/FTLD spectrum. R2 captures many raw features but misattributes the TBK1 pathophysiology to frontotemporal/parkinsonism-17 and omits the specific bulbar EMG. R1 has the vertical gaze and PET support for PSP but does not explain the bulbar motor changes or the genetic variant.

rejected.why: Covers vertical gaze palsy, cognitive impairment, and basal ganglia PET loss, but fails to explain tongue atrophy, bulbar large-amplitude/long-duration EMG units, and TBK1 gene mutation, leaving the lower motor neuron evidence unexplained.
